one_idea.line: Yes. The auditor opening old pages and finding money or a skeleton carries both cuts. In the hook, the line on 'fraction' now goes through the $195,000 instead of under its source line, so the move means 'cut' as the idea says. The panel sits lower (top 380) with his head clear. The other five F1 slam beats, fell's count down, the real pages held still and the sofa and closet plates are unchanged.

no_invented_numbers.line: No invented figure. k_billed and k_after show only the bill-billed and bill-after rows (195,000 and 33,000), and k_billed's panel keeps its producer line ('Tom's Hardware, 29 Oct 2025 (the family's account)') readable. No slam word or tape has a digit. The figures on th_head, l_lede and l_krafton are printed on their own pages. Moving the line changes no figure.

findings.text: On the next render check a frame after w18: the line crosses the digits of 195000, does not clip the producer line, and his head is clear of the panel at top 380.
